ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white patches occupy the lateral sections of both lobes. A low-intensity dark central column separates the white patches. Darker pixel mottling is concentrated along the proximal edges and trailing margins of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible as a shallow V-shaped depression; vertex depth is partially obscured by water, upper aperture suggests an obtuse angle of approximately 150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. High-frequency peaks (5-10 pixels in amplitude) are concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes, transitioning to smoother topography near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smoothly convex curve extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, followed by a sharp inward hook at the distal-most points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark pixel clusters (mottling) along the interior margins of the white patches; no distinct high-contrast circular rosette scars visible.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three parallel, diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white patch on the left lobe; one horizontal linear mark visible on the lower-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear rake marks on the left lobe; dark pigmented irregularity at the extreme right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined dark circular splotch located in the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe's white patch.
